Blessed is the one who reads and keeps what is written here. How can you read Revelation with hope rather than fear?
Jesus loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood. How does this shape your worship?
John sees the risen Jesus in glory. Which part of the description stands out to you?
Jesus says, "Fear not, I am the first and the last." What fears does he speak into?
Ephesus had good works but had abandoned their first love. How is your first love for Jesus?
Jesus says to Smyrna, "Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life." Where do you need courage to be faithful?
Pergamum held fast to Jesus' name but tolerated wrong teaching. Where might you be tolerating something you shouldn't?
Jesus knows Thyatira's love, faith, service and endurance. What would he say he knows about you?
Sardis had a reputation of being alive but was dead. How can you stay spiritually awake?
Jesus has set before Philadelphia an open door. What open door might God be giving you?
Laodicea was lukewarm and thought it needed nothing. Where might you be self-sufficient instead of relying on Jesus?
"Behold, I stand at the door and knock." What does it mean to open the door to Jesus?
John sees a throne in heaven with God seated on it. What does this vision tell you about who is in control?
The living creatures never stop saying, "Holy, holy, holy." What does God's holiness mean to you?
The elders cast their crowns before the throne. What would it look like to give God all the glory?
No one was found worthy to open the scroll, but the Lion of Judah has conquered. Why is Jesus alone worthy?
The Lion is revealed as a Lamb who was slain. What does this tell you about how Jesus conquered?
People from every tribe, language and nation are ransomed. What does this show about God's heart for the world?
All creation sings, "Worthy is the Lamb." How can your life join this song?
John sees riders bringing conquest, war, famine and death. How does knowing God is still on the throne help in a troubled world?
The martyrs cry, "How long, O Lord?" When have you prayed that prayer?
People cry out, "Who can stand?" What is the answer to that question?
God's servants are sealed before judgement. What does it mean to belong to God?
A great multitude from every nation stands before the throne. What do you imagine when you picture this crowd?
God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. What tears are you longing for God to wipe away?
The prayers of the saints rise like incense before God. How does this encourage your prayers?
The trumpets bring judgement on the earth. What does this show about the seriousness of sin?
Even in judgement, God limits the harm done. What does this show about God's control?
People still did not repent of their idols. Why do people hold on to idols even in hardship?
The mighty angel declares there will be no more delay. How does God's timing comfort you?
John eats the scroll, sweet in his mouth but bitter in his stomach. How can God's word be both sweet and hard?
God's two witnesses speak faithfully in hard times. How can you be a faithful witness?
The witnesses were killed but God raised them up. What does this show about God's final victory?
"The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ." What does this mean for you now?
The dragon tried to destroy the child, but God protected him. What does this show about God's protection?
They conquered the accuser by the blood of the Lamb and the word of their testimony. What is your testimony?
The dragon makes war on those who keep God's commands. How does knowing the battle is real help you?
The beast receives worship and power for a time. What does this call for in God's people?
"Here is a call for the endurance and faith of the saints." Where do you need endurance?
The second beast deceives many. How can you avoid being deceived?
The redeemed follow the Lamb wherever he goes. What does it mean for you to follow him?
The angel proclaims the eternal gospel: fear God and give him glory. How can you give him glory today?
"Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord." What hope does this give?
The harvest of the earth is gathered in. What does this show about God's justice?
The victors sing, "Great and amazing are your deeds, O Lord God the Almighty!" What great deeds of God would you sing about?
The temple is filled with smoke from God's glory. What does this show about his holiness?
The angel says God's judgements are true and just. How do you see God's justice?
Jesus says, "Behold, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake." How can you stay ready?
Even under judgement, people curse God rather than repent. Why does a hard heart refuse to turn?
The great prostitute is drunk with the blood of the saints. What does this show about the world's opposition to God's people?
The beast and the kings have power for a time. What does this show about earthly power?
The Lamb will conquer, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings. How does this give you courage?
"Come out of her, my people." What might God be calling you to come out of?
The merchants mourn the fall of Babylon's wealth. What does this show about trusting in riches?
Heaven rejoices that God has given judgement. Why is God's justice good news?
A great multitude cries, "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God." What moves you to praise?
"Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb." What does this picture of Jesus and his people mean?
Jesus rides out called Faithful and True. Which of his names speaks to you most?
The beast and false prophet are defeated. What does this show about how the story ends?
The saints reign with Christ. What does this show about how God honours his faithful people?
Satan is finally defeated. How does this give you hope today?
The dead are judged before the great white throne. Why is having your name in the book of life so important?
God will dwell with his people and there will be no more death or pain. What are you most longing for in the new creation?
God says, "Behold, I am making all things new." What do you long for God to make new?
The holy city shines with the glory of God. What does this vision tell you about God's people?
The city has no temple, for God and the Lamb are its temple. What does it mean to live in God's presence forever?
The river of life flows from the throne, and they will see his face. What does it mean to see God's face?
Jesus says, "Behold, I am coming soon." How does this shape how you live?
"Let the one who is thirsty come." Who could you invite to come to Jesus?
John prays, "Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!" Can you pray that today, and what does it mean to you?
